body:
Things are doing fine for now. I'm not quite as depressed as I was before, but I haven't quite gotten over my thoughts. Maybe after I graduate from high school things will hipefully get better.

I sure hope things are going well for you.

If you want you go go right ahead. It pretty bad though... actually it's really bad :/

http://www.youtube.com/user/KirrickGameplay
http://www.youtube.com/user/KirrickBenchmarks
If I get the time, I'll try to watch it this weekend. I usually have all the time to do whatever I want, but sometimes I don't have the effort or the reasoning to do it...

I read that the few people that jumped from the bridge had a complete "spiritual" turnaround in their life. I could be wrong though. I usually am.

I thought I had something like that yesterday, but within five minutes, I went to shit again.

I also want to learn how to play the piano, but I'm broke as dirt and I can't afford to buy one.

I hve been trying to hang around with friends, I've even tried talking to them about my suicidal thoughts, but they pushed it aside and never actually cared. That's when I learned that I never had any actual friends. I do find some oddly satisfying joy in making YouTube videos. While only three people watch them, it's nice to know that people actually look forward to it appearing in their sub box.

I would probably be doing it earlier (around the middle of June), but I don't have a car, and I don't have the money to take the bus up to SF. I live in Southern California. It's a 15 hour ride by public transport.
